notablePrerequisites:
Fable of the Mirror-Breaker has exactly two lore counters on it.
"Goblin" or "Shaman" chosen with Molten Echoes.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker triggers, causing you to put a lore counter on it.
Fable of the Mirror-Breaker's third chapter ability triggers, exiling it, and returning it to the battlefield as Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
When Reflection of Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Activate the token Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the nontoken Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the tapped Reflection of Kiki-Jiki token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
